scope: Derived conditions and a one-factor forecast-vintage stress; no fitting, parameter changes or annual-model rebuild

MISO.background: Matched no-new-growth background with anticipated resources and published response
MISO.candidate: Current displayed national reference, quarter-rate taper, core reported-MW capture, reference peak mapping and midpoint allocation
MISO.reported_condition: Largest one-factor growth scale meeting every annual constraint; also report endpoint-only limit and binding year

ERCOT.background: Official gross demand, anticipated native resources and published ordinary response, with provisional response excluded initially
ERCOT.reported_condition: Smallest common effective provisional-response fraction meeting every annual constraint
ERCOT.scale_comparison: At 2035 compare required effective reduction to the source's 25-GW new-DC increment only as an explicitly conditional upper-bound comparison

PJM.sources: 2025 and 2026 official load-report workbooks, Table B1, PJM RTO row
PJM.required_reconciliation: All ten 2025-vintage gross peaks must equal the retained native inputs before applying differences
PJM.stress: Replace only gross demand by the 2026-vintage values; hold native resource contributions, response and each year-specific reference margin fixed
PJM.report: All four resource-response conditions, first year below requirement, duration, endpoint balance and annual changes
PJM.interpretation: Forecast-vintage stress, not a complete 2026 adequacy forecast, observed validation or DC-only attribution

constant_controls: Each resource fraction, growth scale and response fraction is common to all ten years; no year-by-year selection of favorable settings
